title: ops.shape returns scalar Tensor instead of tuple for hann_window/kaiser_window outputs in Graph mode
duplicate_search_queries: site:github.com/mindspore-ai/mindspore/issues kaiser_window ops.shape Graph mode Tensor shape
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 local ops.shape docstring says the return value is tuple[int].
MindSpore 2.9 local hamming_window, hann_window and kaiser_window docstrings list CPU as a supported platform and return a 1-D tensor.
The reproduced output tensor has shape (5,) in both modes; only ops.shape(y) changes from tuple to scalar Tensor for hann_window and kaiser_window in Graph mode.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: the reproducer checks metadata type/structure, not floating-point values.
Not a general CPU unsupported issue: all tested window functions return tensors successfully on CPU.
The hamming_window control returns tuple shape metadata in both PyNative and Graph mode.
The likely localized area is Graph-mode shape inference for tensors created by the Python-composed hann_window and kaiser_window implementations.
